messages:
Maya: quick async check — doing a small 'ship junction' sweep for QTR milestone. need 1) what actually shipped, 2) what slipped, 3) immediate deps and owners. trying to avoid a big sync.
Ravi: shipped: routing v2 toggled in prod last week, canary at 100%, perf looks stable. docs PR merged. :tada:
Jules: slipped: promo-tier autoscale work — blocked by infra quota request. estimated now EOW next week. noted in ticket RW-231.
Sofia: dependency: telemetry schema change from data-team — affects rollout gating for canaries. pinged @Leo for status.
Leo: data-team says schema deploy done in staging, production rollout scheduled tomorrow 03:00 UTC. I've added a fallback to ignore extra fields to be safe.
Maya: cool. Jules — can you own pushing the autoscale quota request through? If you want, I can escalate to infra.
Jules: I filed the support escalation RW-445 this morning. if no response by EOD, please escalate @Maya. I'm also dropping a small patch to make autoscale config tolerant.
Ravi: small ops note — routing v2 has a short window of increased tail latency during cold-starts; I've added a short-lived circuit-breaker in config: `circuit_breaker.ms = 250`.
Maya: thanks. let's record concrete next steps:
- Jules: follow up on RW-445 escalation; patch for autoscale tolerance (owner: Jules, ETA: 2026-03-20)
- Leo: prod rollout of telemetry schema (owner: Leo, ETA: 2026-03-18 03:00 UTC)
- Ravi: monitor routing v2 tail latency and adjust circuit-breaker if needed (owner: Ravi, ETA: 24h)
- Maya: escalate infra if quota not resolved (owner: Maya, ETA: 2026-03-19)
Sofia: quick Q — do we need a model-regression eval before we flip routing for dedicated customers?
Ravi: good call. for dedicated customers we'll gate with the regression suite `eval/regress/routing_v2.yml`. it takes ~45m to run. recommend running it tomorrow after telemetry prod rollout.
Maya: agree. add one more step: run regression suite post-telemetry rollout (owner: Ravi, ETA: 2026-03-18 +45m).
Jules: small PR in progress: `infra/auto-scale: tolerate missing quota` — will ping for CR in ~2h.
Maya: who can CR? @Sofia or @Leo?
Sofia: I can do a quick CR after lunch.
Leo: can also spot-check infra changes after Sofia.
deploy-bot: deploy started: infra-schema-rollout -> staging (build #872)
Maya: thanks deploy-bot. final ask: if any slips change milestone scope, post here with the ticket and proposed scope change. we'll keep this channel as the async record. :memo:
Ravi: noted. will post regression results here once done. :eyes:
Jules: escalation update — infra replied, bumped quota to 2x, ETA for full capacity 2026-03-20 10:00 UTC. updating RW-445.
Maya: good progress. closing loop: if autoscale ETA slips past milestone cutoff we'll spin a temporary throttle plan and notify customers.
Sofia: ack. I'll schedule a short checkout thread if we need to notify PMs.
Maya: thanks all. short status please in the morning; this thread will be the single source of truth for owners/deps for the milestone. :thumbsup:
